author: agent
objective: Estimate the association of short-term municipality-level PM2.5 with all-cancer mortality in Brazil.

scientific_invariants.research_question: Estimate the association of short-term municipality-level PM2.5 with all-cancer mortality in Brazil.
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: Daily all-cancer deaths among Brazilian residents recorded in SIM.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Odds ratio per 10 micrograms per cubic metre increase in lag 0-2 PM2.5.
principal_variants: All-cancer mortality, lag 0-2 PM2.5, conditional logistic regression

article_evidence.finding: Study abstract: Brazilian individual SIM cancer deaths, 2000-2019; municipal daily PM2.5; three-day average; OR per 10 ug/m3.

Complete methods recovered through the open-access article route: 5,570 municipalities, SIM, 0.25-degree daily modelled PM2.5, ERA5 meteorology, population-weighted municipality aggregation, time-stratified case-crossover conditional logistic regression.

execution_design.geographic_representation: Bounded Sao Paulo municipality (IBGE 3550308) feasibility slice, May 2000, within the locked Brazilian-municipality target.
execution_design.source_strategy: Official SIM annual CSV outcomes; article-linked OSF all-source PM2.5 0.25-degree product; Open-Meteo archival ERA5-backed daily weather.
execution_design.assignment_method: Unweighted mean of 0.25-degree grid-cell centres inside the Sao Paulo municipal polygon; declared substitute for population-weighted municipal aggregation.
execution_design.daily_aggregation: Daily mean across in-polygon grid predictions; lag 0-2 is the arithmetic mean of current and preceding two days.
execution_design.exposure_metric: Three-day lag 0-2 mean all-source PM2.5 in micrograms per cubic metre.
execution_design.analysis_aggregation: Individual cancer-death matched strata with same-weekday referent days in the same calendar month and year; conditional logistic regression.
execution_design.coverage_policy: Report-only; retain all events with complete lagged PM2.5 and weather in this bounded slice.
execution_design.intended_use: Bounded article-aligned feasibility estimate, not a national reproduction.
execution_design.execution_design: Official SIM CSV archive replaces timeout-prone legacy DBC FTP for outcomes; no change to scientific target.

changed_dimensions.geographic_representation: Municipality boundaries; feasibility slice starts with São Paulo municipality identified by SIM municipality-of-residence code 3550308, then expands only after observed outcome and exposure coverage.
changed_dimensions.source_strategy: Outcome: official Ministry of Health SIM annual CSV archive. Exposure: public OpenAQ historical monitor data discovered and assigned through AERIS; meteorology: public gridded daily source only if needed and available.
changed_dimensions.assignment_method: For a bounded municipal slice, assign each municipality-day the nearest available public PM2.5 monitor after AERIS catalog discovery; retain monitor ID and distance. This is a monitor-based municipal proxy, not a population-weighted area concentration.
changed_dimensions.daily_aggregation: Mean valid hourly PM2.5 measurements per local calendar day; retain daily hour count and report it.
changed_dimensions.exposure_metric: Arithmetic mean of same municipality-assigned daily PM2.5 for event day and preceding two days (lag 0–2), µg/m³.
changed_dimensions.analysis_aggregation: One row per municipality-day cancer death count; construct time strata only after exact article stratum rule is recovered.
changed_dimensions.coverage_policy: Report all outcome, PM2.5, and covariate missingness and monitor distances. A bounded slice uses successful source overlap and is labelled reduced coverage.
changed_dimensions.intended_use: Generate a fit-ready, article-aligned outcome-exposure panel and conditional-regression handoff; published effects do not influence selection or fitting.
changed_dimensions.execution_design: Official SIM CSV archive replaces timeout-prone legacy DBC FTP for outcomes; no change to scientific target.

evidence.finding: Official Ministry portal embeds annual SIM CSV/JSON ZIP resource URLs for every study year.
Downloaded, listed archive contains raw 2000 mortality records.
Maintained client source confirms the legacy DBC transport and its documented FTP dependency.

amendments.scientific_justification: The executable design preserves the article’s target while explicitly documenting a public outcome transport substitution and a monitor-based municipal exposure assignment.

evidence.finding: Decoded article-linked RDS contains daily PM2.5 grid-day records.
Three grid centres fall in the municipal polygon and yield 31 daily values.
Twenty-nine complete lag/weather days and 922 eligible death strata support a fit.

amendments.scientific_justification: Recovered records support a stronger article-linked gridded analysis than the earlier monitor-proxy route. Bounded geography, unweighted aggregation, and holiday non-identifiability are explicit.
